title: HOSA Nutrition: Medical Nutrition Therapy - Nutrition - Medical Nutrition Therapy - Parenteral Nutrition
subject: Nutrition

questions.q: A patient has been on Total Parenteral Nutrition (TPN) for two weeks. The physician orders a gradual transition to enteral feeding. Why is the TPN not stopped abruptly?
options: To allow the stomach to shrink.
questions.explain: TPN contains high concentrations of dextrose, stimulating high insulin levels. Abrupt cessation can cause rapid hypoglycemia (rebound) because insulin levels remain high while glucose supply stops.
